user.title: Add a Switchy panel
user.description: Enter the panel's device id (on its sticker or from the app) and its address on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a panel at that address.
error.wrong_device: That address answers as a different panel.

init.title: Name the panel's channels
init.description: Give each channel (L1, L2, ...) a friendly name. Leave blank to keep the default.
